assessment.repetition: Outputs contain recurring fragments and malformed letter sequences.
assessment.coherence: The generated strings are not coherent English descriptions.
assessment.practical_usability: Not usable as product copy without substantial human rewriting; product claims should not be inferred from these outputs.
limitations: The corpus has 135 synthetic examples with repeated phrasing and only nine personal-care categories.
The reported validation value averages ten sampled windows, not a full corpus pass or a human quality score.
Generation uses sampling without a CLI seed option, so generated text can vary between runs.
This run is a small project evaluation and does not demonstrate production readiness.

smoke_test_distinction: The test suite and the separate short training/generation smoke check verify code paths and artifact loading. They are not quality evaluations. The 200-step run and three outputs above are the actual quality evaluation recorded here.
